newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Coca-Cola plans $1 bln investment in E Europe.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola plans $1 bln investment in E Europe.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co plans to invest one billion dollars in the Eastern part of Europe, including $100 million in both Russia and Poland in 1997, Coca-Cola Chairman Doug Ivester was quoted by the Hungarian daily Vilaggazdasag on Tuesday as saying.
Coca-Cola has already invested $1.5 billion in the countries of Central Eastern Europe, of which Hungary took $250 million, Vilaggazdasag said.
Ivester said Coca-Cola is likely to invest $50 million in Hungary in sales development and could boost the staff of its Hungarian subsidiary by up to 300 new employees.
